$comment: The thumb moves because `control.switch-thumb` answers an ancestor's state (`[data-state="checked"] &`), not because the demo sets a class. bits-ui puts data-state on both parts, and the extractor read that off the library's own state module.
$unstyledNote: required is an ARIA/validation state with nothing to draw; unchecked and off are resting states - the base declarations ARE their appearance; disabled on the thumb is redundant because the root it sits in dims and the thumb inherits the opacity.
